name: Google Cloud Video Intelligence API
tagline: AI-powered video analysis: labels, shots, objects, and more
description: Google Cloud Video Intelligence API analyzes video content using machine learning. It detects labels, shot changes, objects, faces, logos, text, and speech; supports object tracking and explicit content detection; and works with files in Cloud Storage or as base64-encoded content. Designed for media indexing, moderation, and searchable video archives.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 access token (Bearer) via Application Default Credentials, service account, or user OAuth. API key supported for some calls. Cloud project with Video Intelligence API enabled required.

pricing.free_tier_limits: First 1,000 minutes of video processed per month free (verify current pricing page)
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go after free tier; priced per minute by feature (label detection, shot change, object tracking, etc.)

rate_limits: not published in full; default Cloud quotas apply — check Quotas page in Cloud Console
use_cases: detect object labels and scenes in a video file
find shot changes and scene boundaries in footage
track moving objects across video frames
detect explicit or unsafe content for moderation
extract speech transcripts from video audio
index video archives for searchable media libraries
